extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Glasgow Sheriff Court asks whether funding of £23,000 is available, with matrimonial property of about £230,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the background on your client's financial provision action. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, as our funding is for matters in England and Wales. It would also help to have details of the next court date or key procedural milestones, a breakdown of the costs the £23,000 is intended to cover, and confirmation of how the matrimonial property of around £230,000 is made up. Please also confirm your client's details and your firm's involvement on the record. We will review the information once received and come back to you.
